mapping_notes.company_tax_number: NOT merged into 'vergi kimlik numarası' (tax_id_number): heads of company_tax_of are company subjects; merging would erase the person/company distinction.
mapping_notes.title_honorific: NOT 'unvan' to avoid a stretch-collision with 'iş unvanı' (job_title); these are honorific prefixes such as 'Av.' and 'Op. Dr.'.
mapping_notes.tracked_location: district/city-level tracked positions ('Fatih, İstanbul'); kept apart from 'coğrafi koordinat' (gps_coordinates) and 'işyeri konumu' (workplace_location).
mapping_notes.social_security_number: SGK-style numbers; kept apart from 'kimlik numarası' (national_id_number).
mapping_notes.risk_report: spans are descriptive credit-risk statements, hence 'risk raporu bilgisi' not a bare id name.
mapping_notes.medula_tracking_number|mersis_number|uet: proper system names keep their canonical casing (Medula, MERSİS, UETS, Yupass, MRZ, SIM).
